issues: 背景是通用小字 FakeDashboard，压暗后只剩一片灰；配色是浅灰 + 靛蓝
面板 780px 宽、候选字 24px、键帽 15px，在 1080p 里偏小，联系表上几乎读不出命令名
两次按键只收窄 5→3→2，"挤压感"弱；弹落只有 20px，仪式感不足
面板落地没有光的反馈，整体平淡
changes: look 改 midnight：背景换成为镜头做的暗色部署控制台「Sable」（侧栏 + 流量曲线 + 部署列表），唤出时后退 4%、压暗到 ~42%、blur 12px、降饱和
唤出动机做大：下方 120px ⌘ K 键帽浮现、按下下沉 + 电光蓝底光一闪；面板从 -56px 以 spring damping 14 弹落，落地时背后一次电光蓝泛光
面板放大到 1100px 深色玻璃：输入 48px、命令 34px + 副标题 26px、键帽 24px，候选行与弹落跨骑每 3f 错峰
查询改成三键 "dep"，每一键都有行塌缩：6 → 4 → 3 → 2，匹配片段电光蓝加粗、结果计数同步；面板顶部锚定、收窄后正好落在画面中央
定格：首条高亮从左扫满 + 左缘亮条 + 图标块转实色 + ↵ 键帽弹出，光标转常亮，hold 段 1→1.03 极缓推镜
issuesEn: Background is the generic small-text FakeDashboard that dims into grey mush; light grey + indigo palette
780px panel with 24px rows and 15px keycaps — command names are barely legible at 1080p
Only two keystrokes narrowing 5→3→2, weak squeeze; a 20px drop gives little ceremony
No light response when the panel lands; the whole shot feels flat
changesEn: Midnight look: background replaced by a camera-made dark deploy console 'Sable' (sidebar, traffic chart, deploy list) that recedes 4%, dims to ~42%, blurs 12px and desaturates on summon
Bigger motivation: 120px ⌘ K keycaps rise, press down with an electric-blue under-glow; the panel drops from -56px on a damping-14 spring with one blue bloom behind it
Panel enlarged to 1100px dark glass: 48px input, 34px commands + 26px subtitles, 24px keycaps; rows stagger every 3f overlapping the drop
Three-key query 'dep' where every key collapses rows: 6 → 4 → 3 → 2, matches bolded in blue, count updates; top-anchored panel ends centred in frame
Final state: first row highlight sweeps in from the left with an edge bar, solid icon tile and a popping ↵ keycap; caret goes steady; slow 1→1.03 push in the hold
